current.text: The starting guard spot next to Curry is not settled. Podziemski, Melton and Santos compete for it.
Experts project him to come off the bench. He has an outside shot to start.
If he starts and plays about 28 minutes, he is worth drafting or adding in 12-team leagues. In that case he can beat last season's rank of 179.
His recovery from the ACL injury is still a concern.
Tier 9 in point guard tier rankings.
Josh expects him to do a bit more than last season.
Golden State's depth is very poor. Jimmy Butler is out for at least half the season and Moses Moody is out early, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Steve Kerr runs unpredictable rotations and often changes his starting lineup a few games into the season.
The Warriors may treat this as a gap year with an eye on lottery odds. Experts expect them to rest veterans, and expect Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs this season, tied for second most.
The Warriors' playoff schedule is good for a season ending March 28.

durable.text: He is a steals specialist. Steals are his clear best category.
He is a career above-average three-point shooter, at 36 to 39% before his slump last season after returning from injury.
He is a good defender but not a primary creator.
His FG% is low for a guard.
He has had an ACL injury.

note: Both sites price him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 250, ESPN 181), and our league drafts only 144 players, so he is a 1 USD flyer at most and more likely an early waiver add. His value comes from steals (about 1.6 per game, z +2.1 vs the pool), so he fits steals-chasing and punt FG% builds, since his roughly 41% FG on 11 attempts hurts. In the first weeks, check whether he wins the open starting guard spot and plays about 28 minutes, and watch how his knee holds up.
